# OFS-2: Estimated foreign holdings of U.S. Treasury securities (millions)
# From Treasury Bulletin Dec 2013, table OFS-2, "Foreign and international" holdings
# March 2003 and March 2012 values (as reported in the FY2013 bulletin)
foreign_mar_2003 = 1144881.0  # millions, March 2003
foreign_mar_2012 = 5145698.0  # millions, March 2012

n = 2012 - 2003  # 9 years
cagr_foreign = (foreign_mar_2012 / foreign_mar_2003) ** (1.0 / n) - 1

# Nominal U.S. GDP (BEA), billions, annual
# Year 2003 and 2012
gdp_2003 = 11512.2   # billions
gdp_2012 = 16197.0   # billions
cagr_gdp = (gdp_2012 / gdp_2003) ** (1.0 / n) - 1

ratio = cagr_foreign / cagr_gdp
print(round(ratio, 1))
